reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding under this rule.

The cited paragraphs contain no MFN or best-terms obligation running against AbbVie (Customer): Section 5.9.1 restricts Harpoon's dealings with Third Parties, Section 5.9.3 is a notice/copy right in AbbVie's favour regarding Proposed Future In-Licensed Rights, and Section 6.1 is a simple upfront payment.

Consistent with the detection guidance, any third-party-terms mechanics here either burden the Vendor or are optional elections for us, so marking compliant and not redlining is correct; the rationale accurately reflects the cited text and states this meets the preferred position.
